about: Analyst ratings found by web research for stocks that Yahoo Finance does not cover. Maintained by a weekly scheduled task; read by build_dashboard.py. n = number of analysts found (0 = searched, none found). rating: strong_buy | buy | hold | underperform | sell | null. checked = date researched; asOf = date of the newest analyst view found.

CHT.note: No US-listed ADR targets found; these are converted from local Taiwan-share targets (avg NT$136.5, range NT$118-150, all six analysts at Hold) at 10 shares per ADR and about 32.93 TWD per USD. Local consensus sits well below the current price.

PAG.brokers: Barclays, JPMorgan, Stephens, Citi, UBS, BofA, Morgan Stanley
PAG.note: MarketBeat shows a Moderate Buy with an even 5 Buy / 5 Hold split; TipRanks' 3-month view leans Hold. The average target sits slightly below the current price.

AXTA.brokers: RBC, Wells Fargo, JPMorgan, Barclays, BofA, KeyBanc, Goldman Sachs
AXTA.note: Views are split: 10 of 18 analysts rate it Hold, and MarketBeat labels the consensus Hold, while S&P and TipRanks lean Buy. After Q3 the targets cluster in the mid-$30s to mid-$40s.

BRZE.brokers: Wells Fargo, Barclays, Citi, TD Cowen, Stifel, Cantor, Canaccord, Loop
BRZE.note: Salesforce agreed to buy Braze for $47.50 a share in cash. Nearly every analyst then cut to Hold and set targets at or near the deal price.

CROX.brokers: Needham, Barclays, Baird, Piper Sandler, UBS, Stifel, Goldman Sachs, Williams Trading
CROX.note: Targets went up sharply after the strong Q3 beat in late October (Needham to $190; Goldman, the only Sell, to $128). The stock now trades at roughly the average target; TipRanks shows a more mixed Buy/Hold split.

GSAT.note: Amazon agreed in April 2026 to buy Globalstar for $90 a share, and both post-deal targets equal that price. Older pre-deal targets (Deutsche Bank $62, Clear Street $71) drag MarketBeat's average down to about $75.67.

LLYVA.note: No current broker coverage found for Liberty Live. The only broker views are Seaport's Buy calls from 2023-2024, which are too old to count; Zacks and Weiss quant ratings are excluded.

RLI.note: Coverage is cautious, with two Sells (Wells Fargo, Jefferies), Holds and one Buy (KBW). Most targets sit below the current price.

RUSHB.note: These targets are from Rush Enterprises coverage, which is published on the Class A shares (about $46.6) and is post-split. RUSHB trades well above Class A, so the targets look low against the RUSHB price. Investing.com labels the consensus Strong Buy and TipRanks Moderate Buy.

VLTO.brokers: BMO, Stifel, Barclays, Citi, Baird, UBS, RBC
VLTO.note: Analysts raised targets across the board after the early-November results. The split is even at 4 Buy / 4 Hold, and TipRanks calls it a Moderate Buy.

COKE.note: No current sell-side ratings or price targets found for Coca-Cola Consolidated; the only entries on TipRanks are AI-model ratings, which are excluded.

IBN.note: Converted from local NSE targets (Trendlyne average Rs1,772; S&P range Rs1,592-2,000, last updated July) at 2 shares per ADR and about 93.47 INR per USD. Almost all of the roughly 41 local analysts rate it Buy or Strong Buy.

PBA.brokers: TD Cowen, Jefferies, ATB Cormark, RBC, CIBC, Raymond James, JPMorgan, Barclays
PBA.note: Targets are set in CAD (about C$74.75 average, C$70-80 range over the past 3 months). I converted them to USD at about 0.698 USD per CAD. MarketBeat's broader 12-month TSX average is lower, at C$69.29.

UNP.brokers: Wells Fargo, Bernstein, BofA, Baird, Susquehanna, Barclays, Citi, JPMorgan, TD Cowen, UBS
UNP.note: TipRanks labels the consensus Strong Buy (11 Buy, 3 Hold). Baird cut to Hold in early November with a $310 target.

BILL.brokers: TD Cowen, Susquehanna, BMO, Truist, William Blair, UBS, Morgan Stanley, Citi, Mizuho
BILL.note: TipRanks counts 10 Buy and 6 Hold. The average target is slightly below the price after a sharp mid-November rally. William Blair upgraded the stock, Susquehanna downgraded it to Hold, and several firms raised targets into the $60s-70s.

DIS.brokers: Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, Morgan Stanley, Wells Fargo, BofA, Barclays, Bernstein, Evercore ISI, Guggenheim, Needham, Raymond James, Rosenblatt, Citi, UBS
DIS.note: All 15 TipRanks analysts rate it Buy, and most raised targets after the mid-November results. MarketScreener's broader October consensus (33 analysts, Buy) was lower at about $127, before those increases.

CHE.brokers: Oppenheimer, UBS, Jefferies, BofA, RBC Capital
CHE.note: Coverage is small: 3 Buy and 2 Hold, with targets raised after late-October results. The average target implies about 11% upside.

AFG.brokers: Wells Fargo, KBW, Piper Sandler, Raymond James
AFG.note: Sources disagree on the label: TipRanks says Hold, MarketScreener says Outperform. Most individual ratings are Hold. The average target is close to the current price.

AIZ.brokers: Morgan Stanley, UBS, Piper Sandler, KBW, BMO, Truist
AIZ.note: Every recent rating is Buy, and four firms raised targets in early-to-mid November. The average target implies roughly 11% upside.

ARGX.brokers: Piper Sandler, Morgan Stanley, H.C. Wainwright, Citi, Wedbush, UBS, Baird
ARGX.note: Nineteen analysts rate it Buy and one (Baird) rates it Hold. The average target sits about 25% above the current price.

BLCO.brokers: Barclays, H.C. Wainwright, RBC, Citi, Leerink, JPMorgan, Deutsche Bank, BofA, Stifel
BLCO.note: Views are split (4 Buy, 5 Hold, 1 Sell), although TipRanks labels the consensus Moderate Buy. Targets rose after the late-October results and imply modest upside.

CBC.brokers: BofA, KBW, Piper Sandler, Morgan Stanley
CBC.note: Three of four recent ratings are Hold, after BofA downgraded in November. The stock trades above the average target.

ADT.brokers: Barclays, Morgan Stanley, BTIG, RBC Capital
ADT.note: Thrive Holdings agreed on Oct 29, 2026 to buy ADT for $10.00 per share in cash, with closing expected in Q1 2027. Analysts have mostly moved to Hold, so the cash offer price matters more than the targets.

AHR.brokers: UBS, Raymond James, Barclays, BMO, BofA, Scotiabank, KeyBanc, Citi, Morgan Stanley
AHR.note: Every covering analyst rates it Buy or Strong Buy. TipRanks' 3-month figure is similar ($62.36 across 12 analysts). The average implies about 9% upside.

AMRX.brokers: UBS, Leerink, JPMorgan, Oppenheimer, Goldman Sachs, Barclays
AMRX.note: All recent ratings are Buy, and several firms raised targets after early-November results. The average implies about 13% upside.

BOX.brokers: UBS, Citi, BofA, Morgan Stanley, D.A. Davidson, RBC, William Blair
BOX.note: UBS upgraded to Buy on Nov 19, raising its target to $55, and Citi and BofA are also bullish. TipRanks' late-October snapshot still showed a split Hold consensus averaging about $40.

CP.brokers: Bernstein, Argus, TD Cowen, Susquehanna, Stifel, RBC, Scotiabank, UBS, JPMorgan, CIBC, Citi, Stephens
CP.note: TipRanks shows 17 Buy and 4 Hold. StockAnalysis's broader count (30 analysts, Buy) gives a nearly identical average of about $99. Some targets are converted from CAD.

DRI.brokers: Bernstein, Citi, KeyBanc, JPMorgan, BofA, BTIG, Wells Fargo, BMO, Mizuho, Evercore ISI, Guggenheim, Morgan Stanley, UBS
DRI.note: TipRanks counts 15 Buy and 6 Hold. The average target is only slightly above the current price. StockAnalysis's larger panel (28 analysts) averages about $233.

EG.brokers: Mizuho, KBW, Citi, Wells Fargo, Cantor Fitzgerald, UBS, Morgan Stanley, Barclays, BofA, RBC
EG.note: The label is Moderate Buy, but 7 of 11 analysts rate it Hold. Targets moved up after early-November results, and the average is roughly in line with the price.

AAPL.brokers: Bernstein, China Renaissance, KeyBanc, BofA, JPMorgan, Barclays, UBS, Citi, Morgan Stanley, TD Cowen, Jefferies
AAPL.note: The consensus is Buy, but several firms rate it Sell (including Barclays, Jefferies and KeyBanc). The average target is slightly below the current price.

A.brokers: Deutsche Bank, Bernstein, UBS, Morgan Stanley, TD Cowen, BofA, Barclays
A.note: TipRanks shows 12 Buy and 3 Hold, with targets raised in October. MarketScreener's September consensus (22 analysts, Buy) was lower at about $175.

ADP.note: TipRanks shows 4 Buy, 10 Hold and 1 Sell over the past 3 months, so the stock sits at Hold with the average target roughly at the current price. StockAnalysis (18 analysts, $290.40, Oct 23) and a MarketBeat summary (12 analysts, $276.36, Oct 25) also say Hold but with lower, older averages.

BDX.brokers: Wells Fargo (upgraded to Buy $242), UBS/Jefferies $242, Citi $241, Barclays (Sell $195)
BDX.note: Targets jumped after early-November results; TipRanks counts 5 Buy, 5 Hold, 1 Sell for a Moderate Buy. StockAnalysis still shows a pre-results Buy consensus of 16 analysts at $195.57 (Oct 7), which looks stale.

CAH.brokers: BofA $320, UBS $310, Argus $309, Morgan Stanley $306, JPMorgan (Hold $286)
CAH.note: TipRanks lists 11 Buy and 1 Hold, a Strong Buy, as of Nov 13; StockAnalysis has an older Buy consensus (17 analysts, $271.47, Oct 16). MarketBeat headlines show later raises (Wells Fargo to $321 on Nov 17, Barclays on Nov 18) that are not yet in the average.

CB.brokers: Roth MKM (Buy $410), Citi (Buy $405), Goldman (Buy $403), JPMorgan (Hold $374), BofA (Sell $335)
CB.note: Sources disagree on the label: TipRanks shows 4 Buy, 10 Hold, 1 Sell (Hold), while StockAnalysis/S&P labels it Buy (25 analysts, avg $371.48) and Investing.com calls it Buy despite more Holds than Buys. Rating set by the Hold majority in the rating counts; average targets cluster around $367-375.

CCEP.brokers: Argus $118, Wells Fargo $115, Goldman $113, Barclays $112, JPMorgan (Sell $92)
CCEP.note: USD targets for the Nasdaq listing; TipRanks (as of Oct 31) has 7 Buy, 3 Hold, 1 Sell, and StockAnalysis is similar (13 analysts, $109.19). The stock now trades above that average, and MarketBeat headlines show target raises in November (to $115 on Nov 4, Barclays on Nov 5 and Nov 19) not yet reflected.

CDW.brokers: UBS $195, JPMorgan $195, Morgan Stanley $193, Evercore $185, Citi (Hold $170)
CDW.note: TipRanks shows 5 Buy and 2 Hold after early-November results, averaging $181 over six targets. A MarketBeat headline puts the consensus target lower at $169.38 (Nov 17), and its Barclays raise on Nov 16 is not in the TipRanks figure.

CL.brokers: UBS $112, Morgan Stanley $111, BNP Paribas Exane $108; Holds at Barclays, Wells Fargo, TD Cowen, Bernstein
CL.note: TipRanks has 8 Buy and 4 Hold with an average near $102; StockAnalysis (21 analysts, $101.70) and a MarketBeat headline ($101.22, Nov 18) agree closely.

CR.brokers: BMO $260, D.A. Davidson $255, BofA $250, Stifel $247, UBS/Deutsche $240
CR.note: All six analysts on TipRanks in the last 3 months rate it Buy. StockAnalysis also shows Strong Buy but from older data (10 analysts, $237.20, mid-September).

DEO.brokers: Jefferies (Buy $117), TD Cowen (Buy $110), BofA (Buy $101), Morgan Stanley (Sell $83), UBS (Neutral)
DEO.note: MarketBeat's 18-broker view (Oct 31) is Hold with an even 8 Buy-side vs 8 Hold split plus 2 Sell, average $99.75 for the US ADR. Other sources lean Buy on thinner coverage: TipRanks has only 3 recent analysts (avg $103.33) and StockAnalysis 8 (avg $106.29, Sept data).

DHR.note: All 13 analysts on TipRanks in the last 3 months rate it Buy after late-October results. StockAnalysis also says Strong Buy (25 analysts) but with a lower $244.14 average, and a MarketBeat headline notes DZ Bank cut it to Hold on Oct 29.

DGX.note: TipRanks labels it Moderate Buy though its recent count is 3 Buy vs 4 Hold; StockAnalysis (17 analysts, Buy, $247.73, Sept) and a MarketBeat Moderate Buy headline (Nov 4) support the buy label. Targets are tightly bunched near the share price.

R.note: TipRanks shows 7 Buy and 1 Hold after the Oct 23 results. StockAnalysis gives a Buy label from 11 analysts with a nearly identical $303.67 average.

ARMK.note: TipRanks has 9 Buy and 1 Hold, with several modest target cuts after mid-November results. StockAnalysis calls it Buy (16 analysts, $68.59), so the label is Strong Buy vs Buy depending on source.

BEKE.note: USD per-ADS targets; all 7 recent analysts on TipRanks rate it Buy. StockAnalysis (22 analysts, Strong Buy, $23.92, Aug data) and a MarketBeat headline ($23.64, Oct 22) are close.

CNI.brokers: Wells Fargo $145, Citi $143, Stifel ~$143, Scotiabank/RBC/CIBC ~$142; Holds at JPMorgan, UBS, Barclays, Susquehanna, Raymond James
CNI.note: TipRanks shows the CNI figures in USD, with Canadian-dollar targets apparently converted at about 0.716; it has 7 Buy vs 9 Hold yet labels it Moderate Buy. StockAnalysis (30 analysts, Buy, about $135.90) and a MarketBeat headline ($138.76, Nov 4) are similar.

AWK.brokers: Argus (Buy $165), UBS (downgraded to Hold $162), BofA (Hold $157), Barclays (Sell $127)
AWK.note: TipRanks shows 1 Buy, 4 Hold, 1 Sell with an average roughly at the share price. StockAnalysis (13 analysts, $140.64, Oct 19) and MarketBeat ($140.11, Oct 9) also say Hold but with older, lower averages.
